Correct slam: he bursts out (the hit) and charges: sidestep, or hurdle him for an 'Ole!' bonus. Wrong slam: sheep, empty, or a stack wolf; 'Cold! Freezing!', two extra swaps. Two wrong guesses in a round bring back the sneeze tell

(c) Shuffle: round 1 performs 2 swaps of 1.4 s; the occupied slot equals the scripted permutation (deterministic with --seed). (d) Round 1: sniff during the shuffle -> no trail, 'sneeze' line; sniff held 1.5 s in the window -> trail target == occupied stack; held 1.0 s -> no trail yet. (e) emit ground_pounded on the occupied stack's top -> FM1 HP 3 -> 2, 'burst' then 'windup'; on a wrong stack -> HP unchanged, content spawns, 2 extra swaps. (f) Round 2: when the sniff trail completes, the occupied stack performs exactly one extra swap within 0.3 s and the new slot equals the seeded result. (g) Round 3: a sock is thrown into a stack != occupied within 1.5 s of the whistle; the sniff trail target == the sock stack; ground_pounded on the sock stack -> stack wolf spawns, HP unchanged, later sniffs draw no trail this round; ground_pounded on the seeded occupied stack -> HP 1 -> 0. (h) Two wrong guesses in one round -> occupied stack sneezes every 3 +/- 0.2 s. (i) Guess window expires -> burst with no HP change, charge set. (j) FM1 never damages without a >= 0.8 s wind-up, never leaves the pen, is never damageable outside the burst of a correct slam; leaving the pen resets the round, HP kept. He huffs for 2.5 s: a huff-ribbon VFX from his mouth to the brick house (8, 17, -34); grass and lavender on the plateau flatten, Bertram's flat cap flies off, B3 (working or wrecked) rocks on its skids with the bag blown inside out, the windmill sails spin at 4x for 5 s. Reginald runs out of breath, deflates with a long rude raspberry and zips off in a looping balloon spiral to the north-east
